description: Use when someone asks whether their cookie banner or cookie consent is compliant in the EU (ePrivacy Art. 5(3) and GDPR consent rules). Call without answers to get the checklist items by area, critical ones marked. Call with yes, partial or no per item to get a score, a compliance label and the open items.

answers.description: Item id to answer, e.g. {"c1": "yes", "c3": "partial"}. Unanswered items count as gaps.

name: cookie_consent_check
title: Cookie consent compliance check
